g.text: Controlled information histories: fixed world, different acquired evidence
40 constructed bases; 640 calls; failures included. Error bars: paired-base bootstrap 95% marginal CIs.
Deletion arms remove information. SSC vs lossless prose: +2.5 pp paired-joint difference, 95% CI [-5.0, 10.0].
